subject.gist: Unnamed parents ask Adam Kane for a lasting family home where they can stay connected, retreat when needed, and cook without interruption.

story.text: The unnamed clients want a forever home where their children can be together without losing their own space. Architect Adam Kane works with a sloping site, giving the house a private face to the street and opening it toward gardens and distant views. A spiral stair links the levels, while glimpses of landscape make the route through the house unfold gradually. The clients prefer to cook without being bothered, so the working kitchen sits back from the sculptural island. Adam uses textured brick, warm cabinetry and soft curtains to make the strong forms feel calm, and hopes the house will settle further into its gardens as they mature.
